plan: Keep queueing jungle as primary — it is already Xeebs's usual queue AND best role at 53.8% over 371 games (overall is 50.3%).
Stop queueing carry: 42.9% over 203 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Two-hero rule for the climb: Khaimera and Greystone. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Xeebs wins about 10.8 and 4.1 more games per 100 on them.
Xeebs's champion pool is 13+ heroes wide and the top three are only 40% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
Park Argus, Murdock, Drongo, Serath for ranked: 45% over 127; 46% over 90; 38% over 53; 38% over 50. Keep them for normals.
The math: Xeebs is at 300 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 692.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Xeebs is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 50%. Past 32: 25%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
